annotation.title_clean: Report from the Commission to the European Parliament and the Council: Evaluation of BEREC and the BEREC Office
annotation.title_en: Report from the Commission to the European Parliament and the Council: Evaluation of BEREC and the BEREC Office
annotation.summary_en: Commission report evaluating the performance of BEREC and the BEREC Office (2019–2023) under Regulation 2018/1971. It finds them broadly effective, but says their mandates should adapt to new digital rules including the AI Act, cybersecurity and spectrum, with a stronger Office and better coordination. AI is mentioned only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: BEREC and the BEREC Office are broadly effective in meeting their objectives.
New digital rules (DSA, DMA, Data Act, AI Act) give tasks to authorities that are not NRAs, widening the gap with BEREC's mandate.
The BEREC Office should give more substantive support, especially data collection and analysis.
BEREC should adapt to AI, cybersecurity, sustainability and resilience, and work more closely with RSPG on spectrum.
BEREC and NRA independence must be preserved while responsibilities are clearly delineated.
